name: Marching Cubes with Trilinear Topology Resolution
aliases: Marching Cubes (MC) with Trilinear Topology Resolution
definition: A variant of the Marching Cubes algorithm that accurately reproduces the topology of a piecewise trilinear interpolant by extending the lookup table (LUT) and examining the trilinear interpolant within the cell's interior and faces to resolve ambiguities.
summary: Marching Cubes with Trilinear Topology Resolution accurately reproduces the topology of piecewise trilinear interpolants by resolving face and interior ambiguities that standard algorithms ignore.
